sections.title: Maximizing ROI through Strategic Tax Planning
sections.body: Tax efficiency is a core component of the Kenya AI Compute financial model. By operating within the Special Economic Zones (SEZ) framework, our project benefits from a world-class incentive package. This includes a reduced corporate income tax rate of just 10% for the first ten years of operation—a significant reduction from the standard 30% rate. Furthermore, the SEZ status grants us full exemption from Value Added Tax (VAT) on all project-related purchases and zero customs duties on imported high-tech equipment (servers, GPUs, cooling units). For international investors, the most critical benefit is the 0% withholding tax on dividends and interest payments remitted globally. This ensures a frictionless flow of capital and maximizes the cash yield for our equity partners, making Kenya one of the most fiscally attractive jurisdictions for infrastructure investment in the world. sections.title: Incentive Highlights
items: Corporate Tax: 10% for the first 10 years (Standard: 30%).
Import Duties: 0% on all specialized IT and power equipment.
VAT Exemption: 0% on capital goods and operational expenditures.
Withholding Tax: 0% on dividends paid to international shareholders.
Stamp Duty: Fully exempted on the acquisition of land and project assets.
